title_en: Dangdang Wolf Who Makes Up Excuses
full_text_zh:
[P1] 会编造理由的当当狼
huì biān zào lǐ yóu de dāng dāng láng

[P2] 从前, 有一只狼叫当当。当然, 他的名气也是响当当的。
当当狼不是一只粗鲁的狼, 也不是一只凶笨的狼。相反, 他很聪明, 不过他是一只很爱编造理由的狼。
当当狼在家中做游戏, 把地上弄得很脏。妈妈叫他把地扫一扫。
当当狼说:“好的, 我这就去!”
可是, 他马上为自己找了一个理由:“我为什么不吃完苹果再扫?”
吃完了苹果, 当当狼对自己说:“我为什么不看完这

[P3] 本图画书再扫？！
看完图画书，他又说：“我为什么不……”
等他把所有的理由都想完，窗外已经升起一轮圆月亮。妈妈把当当狼塞进被窝，可是地上还很脏……
有一天，爸爸叫当当狼把一篮苹果和橘子送给住在山后面的外婆。
当当狼提着篮子走出门，走了没多远，他就对自己说：“我口渴了。瞧，这个大苹果水分很足，一定很解渴！”
没说的，那个大苹果进了当当狼的肚子。

[P4] 又走出几步，他瞧着一只橘子说：
“这只橘子的皮有点发青，会不会很
酸？我得尝尝。”
剥去橘子青黄色的皮，橘瓣一片
片飞进当当狼的嘴巴，甜甜的橘汁顺
着他的嘴角往下淌……
接着，当当狼又打起另一个大苹
果的主意：“我不想吃这个大苹果，应
该把它留给外婆。不过，这个大苹果
真够大的，我用不了七天就能把它啃
光。”

[P5] 当当狼说得没错，他才用六口半就把大苹果啃得核儿光光了。
一只小蜜蜂飞来嗡嗡唱，它停在一只金黄色的橘子上。
当当狼死死盯着这只橘子，说：“蜜蜂的眼光挺不错，就是说，这只橘子的味道一定像蜜糖！”
“是不是啊，小蜜蜂？”
蜜蜂飞走了，没理睬当当狼。
当当狼说：“看来，我得自己尝一尝了！”
当当狼三下两下剥了橘子皮，吃了一瓣：“啊，味道果然赛蜜糖！”
当当狼把最后一瓣橘子塞进嘴巴，咂巴咂巴嘴，看得路边的小黑熊也馋得慌。

[P6] 小黑熊要用手中的核桃馅饼来换当当狼篮子里剩下的橘子和苹果。 当当狼心想：送给外婆一个核桃馅饼也不错啊。 他就用篮子里最后的几个苹果、几只橘子和小黑熊换了馅饼。 当当狼捏着馅饼走啊走，他不敢
朝馅饼看。 没过多久，他就忍不住瞧了馅饼一眼，自言自语道：“这馅饼里真有核桃馅儿吗？” 他拿起馅饼闻闻，咬了一小口。
“嗯，真有核桃馅儿！” 他又咬了一口，问自己：“核桃馅儿够不够香甜？”

[P7] “太香甜了！”第三口他差点咬到自己的手指。
一个核桃馅饼什么也没剩下。

当当狼提着空篮子来到外婆家。
外婆瞧了一下空篮子，觉得挺奇怪，她在空篮子里装上几块糖糕，对当当狼说：“要是不是一只小馋狼，

就会把外婆的糖糕带给全家尝尝！”
“不会，我不会是一只小馋狼！”当当狼难为情地说。

回家的路上，篮子里糖糕的香味一阵阵飘来。当当狼担心自己只要朝篮子里一看，就会想出个理由来，把这些糖糕吃掉。

[P8] “我为什么不想出个理由不朝篮子里看呢？”当当狼心想。
“对了！”当当狼对自己说，“篮子里装着的是一只刺猬，一只浑身竖着尖尖刺的刺猬，那家伙讨厌极了……”他一边想一边走。
当当狼经过狐狸和兔子身边，狐狸和兔子伸长脖子闻了闻，说：“篮子里的糖糕好香，多么诱人的味道！”
当当狼加快脚步，说：“什么糖糕？一只刺猬，只不过是一只刺猬……”

[P9] 一直到全家坐在一起享用外婆的糖糕时，当当狼才对自己说：“我想了个多么好的理由保住了糖糕！我要让外婆知道，我并不是只小馋狼！”
full_text_en:
[P1] The Wolf Dangdang Who Makes Up Excuses
huì biān zào lǐ yóu de dāng dāng láng

[P2] Long ago, there was a wolf named Dangdang. Of course, his reputation was also very impressive.
Dangdang Wolf was not a rude wolf, nor was he a fierce and clumsy wolf. On the contrary, he was very smart, but he was a wolf who loved making excuses.
Dangdang Wolf was playing games at home, making the floor very dirty. His mom asked him to sweep the floor.
Dangdang Wolf said: "Okay, I'll go right away!"
But then, he immediately found an excuse for himself: "Why don't I finish eating the apple first and then sweep?"
After finishing the apple, Dangdang Wolf said to himself: "Why don't I finish watching this

[P3] Should I sweep the picture book again?!
After finishing the picture book, he said, "Why shouldn't I...?"
After he thought of all his excuses, a full moon had already risen outside. Mom tucked Dangdang Wolf into bed, but the floor was still dirty...
One day, Dad asked Dangdang Wolf to take a basket of apples and oranges to his grandmother who lived behind the mountain.
Dangdang Wolf carried the basket out the door. After walking a short distance, he said to himself, "I'm thirsty. Look, this big apple is full of juice—it must be very refreshing!"
No doubt about it, that big apple went straight into Dangdang Wolf's stomach.

[P4] He took a few more steps and looked at a tangerine, saying:
"This tangerine's peel is a bit greenish. Could it be very sour? I should taste it."
Peeling off the tangerine's greenish-yellow skin, the segments flew into Dangdang Wolf's mouth, and sweet juice dripped from the corners of his mouth...
Then, Dangdang Wolf had another idea about a big apple: "I don't want to eat this big apple. I should leave it for Grandma. But this big apple is really huge. I won't need seven days to finish it all."

[P5] Dangdang Wolf was right — he had finished the big apple in just six and a half bites, leaving only the core.
A little bee buzzed by and landed on a golden orange.
Dangdang Wolf stared at the orange and said, "The bee's eyesight is pretty good. That means this orange must taste like honey!"
"Is that so, little bee?"
The bee flew away, ignoring Dangdang Wolf.
Dangdang Wolf said, "Well, I guess I'll have to taste it myself!"
Dangdang Wolf peeled the orange in three quick moves and ate a segment: "Ah, the taste is truly like honey!"
He stuffed the last segment into his mouth, chewing and savoring it, making the little black bear by the roadside look hungry too.

[P6] The little black bear wanted to trade his walnut-filled pastry for the remaining oranges and apples in Dangdang Wolf's basket. Dangdang Wolf thought: It wouldn't be bad to give Grandma a walnut-filled pastry. So he traded the last few apples and oranges in his basket for the pastry. Dangdang Wolf walked along, clutching the pastry, and dared not
look at the pastry. After a while, he couldn't resist glancing at the pastry. He muttered to himself, "Does this pastry really have walnut filling?" He picked up the pastry, sniffed it, and took a small bite.
"Hmm, there really is walnut filling!" He took another bite and asked himself, "Is the walnut filling sweet enough?"

[P7] "So sweet!" On the third bite, he almost bit his own finger.
There wasn't a single walnut pie left.

Dangdang Wolf carried the empty basket to Grandma's house.
Grandma looked at the empty basket and felt puzzled. She put a few sweet cakes into the empty basket and said to Dangdang Wolf, "If you weren't a little greedy wolf,

you would bring Grandma's sweet cakes for the whole family to taste!"
"No, I'm not a little greedy wolf!" Dangdang Wolf said embarrassedly.

On the way home, the sweet smell of the cakes drifted from the basket. Dangdang Wolf worried that if he just looked into the basket, he would come up with an excuse to eat them all.

[P8] "Why can't I think of a reason not to look into the basket?" Dangdang Wolf thought to himself.
"Got it!" Dangdang Wolf said to himself, "Inside the basket is a hedgehog, a hedgehog with sharp spines all over its body—what a讨厌 creature..." He walked on, thinking as he went.
As Dangdang Wolf passed by the fox and the rabbit, they stretched their necks to sniff and said, "The cake in the basket smells so good—what a tempting scent!"
Dangdang Wolf quickened his pace and said, "What cake? Just a hedgehog, nothing but a hedgehog..."

[P9] Until the whole family sat together to enjoy Grandma's sweet cakes, Dangdang Wolf said to himself, "I thought of such a good excuse to keep the cakes! I want Grandma to know I'm not just a greedy wolf!"
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本标题页，显示书名《会编造理由的当当狼》。
[P2] 本页介绍了主角当当狼的性格特点——聪明但爱编造理由，并描述了他因玩游戏弄脏地板，妈妈让他打扫时，他立即为自己找借口拖延的情节。
[P3] 本页延续了当当狼爱编造理由的性格，描述他因玩游戏弄脏地板后拖延打扫，以及后来被派送水果给外婆时，又借口口渴吃掉了其中一个苹果的情节。
[P4] 当当狼在送水果的路上，先尝了一个橘子，然后又为吃掉一个大苹果找借口，声称要留给外婆，但又说七天内就能吃完。
[P5] 当当狼在送水果的路上，看到一只蜜蜂停在金黄色的橘子上，便猜测橘子味道像蜜糖。他尝了一瓣后，觉得果然甜美，吃掉最后一瓣时，馋得路边的小黑熊也流口水。
[P6] 当当狼用篮子里剩下的水果和小黑熊换了一个核桃馅饼，他一边走一边不敢看馅饼，但最终忍不住偷吃起来，并自言自语地品尝馅饼的香味。
[P7] 当当狼把水果吃光后空着篮子回到外婆家，外婆发现后装了几块糖糕给他，他承诺会带给全家，但回家路上担心自己忍不住吃掉糖糕，于是不敢看篮子。
[P8] 当当狼为了不让人发现他空篮子的秘密，编造理由说里面装着刺猬。当他经过狐狸和兔子身边时，它们闻到香味以为是糖糕，当当狼急忙否认，坚持说是刺猬，以此掩饰真相。
[P9] 当当狼在全家享用外婆的糖糕时，内心暗自庆幸自己用借口保住了糖糕，并决心让外婆相信自己不是一只贪吃的小狼。
